children.game_version: A ring game where children skip around a central object.

seniors.seated_version: Seated in a circle, performing arm gestures and clapping to the rhythm.
seniors.standing_version: Standing in place, swaying to the music without complex footwork.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular path around a central pole
